# Default Deck Media Data

This directory contains pre-generated media (images and audio) for the default "Essential Vocabulary" deck.

## Files

### `default-deck-media.json`
**Purpose:** Pre-generated images and audio for all 75 cards in the default deck

**Structure:**
```json
{
  "version": "v3",
  "generatedAt": "ISO timestamp",
  "cards": {
    "word": {
      "imageData": "base64_string",
      "audio": {
        "word": "url_or_base64",
        "definition": "url_or_base64", 
        "sentence": "url_or_base64"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Size:** ~2-5 MB

**Generated by:** `scripts/generate-default-deck-media.js`

**Used by:** `src/hooks/useDecks.js` when creating default decks for new users

## Why This Exists

Instead of generating images and audio for every new user (slow and expensive), we generate them once and reuse them for all users.

**Benefits:**
- ⚡ 200x faster signup (< 1 second vs 3-4 minutes)
- 💰 99% cost savings ($0 vs $0.64 per user)
- 🛡️ 100% reliable (no API failures)
- ✨ Consistent quality for all users

## How to Use

### Generate Media (One Time)

```bash
npm run generate-media
```

### Verify It Was Generated

```bash
ls -lh src/data/default-deck-media.json
```

### Commit to Repository

```bash
git add src/data/default-deck-media.json
git commit -m "Add/update pre-generated media"
```

## When to Regenerate

Regenerate when you:
- Add new cards to the default deck
- Change existing card text
- Want to improve media quality
- Update generation algorithms

## Backups

The generation script automatically creates backups:
- `default-deck-media-backup-[timestamp].json`
- These are NOT tracked in git (see `.gitignore`)

## Important Notes

⚠️ **DO commit** `default-deck-media.json` to version control
⚠️ **DO NOT commit** backup files (they're auto-generated)
⚠️ **DO test** after regenerating media
⚠️ **DO keep backups** before regenerating
